items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: Louis I did a wonderful interview with him, he was just great.

ctx.x: It’s something that’s within a human being and he just carried it off like it was part of the program. There are a couple of notes I wanted to mention. Earl “Fatha” Hines was a great piano player. He played wonderful things with Louis. And I did an interview with Earl “Fatha” Hines and he came on and he says, “Look at me” he says, “I’ve been up ‘till four o’clock in the morning” and he says, “I can only give you five minutes.” Two hours later he’s still talking.
